materials.description_en: Bottles, containers, bags and packaging. The resin code tells you what it is.
materials.description_fil: Bote, lalagyan, supot at pakete. Sinasabi ng resin code kung anong plastik ito.

materials.description_en: Clear drink bottles. Widely bought by junk shops when clean.
materials.description_fil: Malinaw na bote ng inumin. Binibili ng junk shop kapag malinis.

materials.description_en: Stiff, opaque bottles like shampoo and detergent. Recyclable when clean.
materials.description_fil: Matigas at malabong bote tulad ng shampoo at sabon. Nare-recycle kapag malinis.

materials.description_en: Pipes, hoses and some blister packs. Rarely recycled.
materials.description_fil: Tubo, hose at ilang blister pack. Bihirang ma-recycle.

materials.description_en: Soft bags and squeeze bottles. Accepted by some programmes when clean and dry.
materials.description_fil: Malambot na supot at bote. Tinatanggap ng ilang programa kapag malinis at tuyo.

materials.description_en: Food tubs, caps and microwavable boxes. Recyclable when clean.
materials.description_fil: Lalagyan ng pagkain, takip at microwavable. Nare-recycle kapag malinis.

materials.description_en: Styrofoam and hard clear cups. Usually residual.
materials.description_fil: Styro at matigas na malinaw na baso. Kadalasang residual.

materials.description_en: Mixed or other resins. Usually residual unless a programme accepts them.
materials.description_fil: Halo o ibang resin. Kadalasang residual maliban kung may programa.

materials.description_en: Clean, dry paper and cardboard are recyclable. Wet, waxed or food-soiled paper is not.
materials.description_fil: Nare-recycle ang malinis at tuyong papel at karton. Hindi ang basa, may wax o may pagkain.

materials.name_fil: Papel na may coating o wax
Papel na may mantsa ng pagkain

materials.description_en: Cans, foil and scrap. Metals keep their value and junk shops buy most of them.
materials.description_fil: Lata, foil at scrap. May halaga ang metal at binibili ng junk shop.

materials.description_en: Bottles and jars are recyclable. Window glass, mirrors and broken glass need care.
materials.description_fil: Nare-recycle ang bote at garapon. Mag-ingat sa salamin ng bintana, salamin at basag.

materials.description_en: Plates, mugs, tiles and pots. Ceramics don't melt with glass, so they go in residual.
materials.description_fil: Pinggan, tasa, tisa at paso. Hindi natutunaw kasama ng bote ang seramika, kaya residual.

materials.description_en: Clothes, linens, shoes and bags. Reuse and donation come first.
materials.description_fil: Damit, kumot, sapatos at bag. Unahin ang paggamit ulit at pag-donate.

materials.description_en: Anything with a plug, battery or circuit board. E-waste goes to registered collectors.
materials.description_fil: Anumang may saksakan, baterya o circuit board. Sa rehistradong kolektor ang e-waste.

materials.description_en: All batteries are special waste. Never put them in a bin loose.
materials.description_fil: Special waste ang lahat ng baterya. Huwag ilagay nang maluwag sa basurahan.

materials.description_en: Bulbs and tubes. Fluorescent lamps contain mercury and need special handling.
materials.description_fil: Bombilya at tubo. May mercury ang fluorescent at kailangan ng espesyal na paghawak.

materials.description_en: Food scraps and garden waste. Compost them or use the green bin.
materials.description_fil: Tirang pagkain at dahon. I-compost o ilagay sa berdeng basurahan.

materials.description_en: Wood, bamboo and cork. Untreated pieces can be reused or composted.
materials.description_fil: Kahoy, kawayan at cork. Puwedeng gamitin ulit o i-compost ang hindi pininturahan.

materials.description_en: Rubber, foam and tires. Hard to recycle, so reuse comes first.
materials.description_fil: Goma, foam at gulong. Mahirap i-recycle, kaya unahin ang paggamit ulit.

materials.description_en: Items made of layers that can't be separated, like cartons and pouches.
materials.description_fil: Gamit na gawa sa patong-patong na hindi mapaghiwalay, tulad ng karton at pouch.

materials.description_en: Medicine, sharps and sanitary items. Sharps and medicine need special handling.
materials.description_fil: Gamot, karayom at pangkalinisan. Kailangan ng espesyal na paghawak ang karayom at gamot.

materials.description_en: Paints, chemicals, pesticides and oils. Keep them in their containers for hazardous collection.
materials.description_fil: Pintura, kemikal, pesticide at langis. Iwan sa lalagyan para sa koleksyon ng mapanganib.

materials.description_en: Furniture, mattresses, appliances and debris too big for household bins.
materials.description_fil: Muwebles, kutson, appliance at debris na masyadong malaki para sa basurahan.

local_rules.note_en: In Quezon City: trade PET bottles for Environmental Points at Trash to Cashback booths.
In Quezon City: Trash to Cashback booths accept clean sachets and other single-use plastic packaging.
In Quezon City: Trash to Cashback booths accept clean single-use plastic packaging like chip bags.
In Quezon City: glass was added to Trash to Cashback. Check with your booth first.
In Quezon City: Trash to Cashback accepts styrofoam only at the QC Hall booth.
In Quezon City, restaurants may not give single-use straws for dine-in (SP-2876).
In Quezon City, restaurants may not give single-use cutlery for dine-in (SP-2876).
Quezon City has ordinances on used fluorescent lamps. Ask your barangay where to bring them.

items.summary_en: Tape the ends and keep used batteries in a closed jar. Bring them to the red bin or a battery drop-off.
items.summary_fil: Takpan ng tape ang dulo at itabi sa saradong garapon. Dalhin sa pulang basurahan o battery drop-off.

items.summary_en: Keep it capped and bring leftovers to hazardous waste collection.
items.summary_fil: Panatilihing nakatakip at dalhin ang natira sa koleksyon ng mapanganib.

items.summary_en: Have a technician remove it and recover the gas, then use take-back or an e-waste collector.
items.summary_fil: Ipaalis sa technician at ipabawi ang gas, saka gamitin ang take-back o e-waste collector.

items.summary_en: Empty it and crush it, then drop it in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Ubusin at pisain, saka ilagay sa asul na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Wipe it clean and scrunch it into a ball for the blue bin. Greasy foil goes in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Punasan at buuin nang pabilog para sa asul. Ang may mantikang foil ay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Pop it and put it in the black bin. Never release balloons outdoors.
items.summary_fil: Paputukin at ilagay sa itim na basurahan. Huwag pakawalan ang lobo sa labas.

items.summary_en: Break sharp tips, then place it in the green bin.
items.summary_fil: Baliin ang matulis na dulo, saka ilagay sa berdeng basurahan.

items.summary_en: Remove stickers, then compost or use the green bin.
items.summary_fil: Tanggalin ang sticker, saka i-compost o ilagay sa berdeng basurahan.

items.summary_en: Wrap used bandages in paper and put them in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Balutin sa papel ang gamit na benda at ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Tape the terminals. Take it to a battery collection point.
items.summary_fil: Takpan ng tape ang dulo. Dalhin sa koleksyon ng baterya.

items.summary_en: Donate clean ones or sew them into bags and rags. The black bin is the last stop.
items.summary_fil: I-donate ang malinis o tahiin bilang bag at basahan. Ang itim ang huling destinasyon.

items.summary_en: Patch punctures first. Old inner tubes make strong straps; worn ones go in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Tapalan muna ang butas. Nagagawang matibay na tali ang lumang interior; ang sira ay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Use it up as directed. Leftover bleach goes to hazardous waste collection in its bottle.
items.summary_fil: Gamitin ayon sa direksyon. Ang natira ay dalhin sa koleksyon ng mapanganib, nasa bote nito.

items.summary_en: Empty blister packs are plastic and foil together. Put them in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Pinagsamang plastik at foil ang walang lamang blister pack. Ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Bones and seafood shells go in the green bin. They break down slowly, so skip small home composts.
items.summary_fil: Ang buto at kabibe ay sa berdeng basurahan. Mabagal silang mabulok kaya huwag sa maliit na compost.

items.summary_en: Wrap the pieces well, label BASAG and put them in the black bin, never loose.
items.summary_fil: Balutin nang mabuti ang piraso, lagyan ng BASAG at ilagay sa itim, hindi kailanman nang walang balot.

items.summary_en: Open windows and leave the room for 15 minutes. Then collect the pieces with stiff paper into a sealed jar.
items.summary_fil: Buksan ang bintana at lumabas nang 15 minuto. Saka ipunin ang piraso gamit ang matigas na papel sa saradong garapon.

items.summary_en: Wrap it well and label it "sharp". Give it to staff.
items.summary_fil: Balutin nang mabuti at lagyan ng "BASAG". Ibigay sa staff.

items.summary_en: Natural brooms go in the green bin. Remove plastic handles and wire first.
items.summary_fil: Ang natural na walis ay sa berde. Tanggalin muna ang plastik na hawakan at alambre.

items.summary_en: Keep it and reuse it for packing. When it's torn, put it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Itabi at gamitin ulit sa pag-iimpake. Kapag punit na, ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Tape both sides, keep them away from children, and bring them to battery collection.
items.summary_fil: Takpan ng tape ang magkabilang side, ilayo sa bata, at dalhin sa koleksyon ng baterya.

items.summary_en: Sell, donate or repair it. Otherwise, take it apart and ask for bulky pickup.
items.summary_fil: Ibenta, i-donate o ipaayos. Kung hindi, baklasin at itanong ang bulky pickup.

items.summary_en: Take out the battery, then bring both to an e-waste or battery drop-off.
items.summary_fil: Alisin ang baterya, saka dalhin pareho sa e-waste o battery drop-off.

items.summary_en: Battery shops take old car batteries when you buy a new one, and many junk shops buy them.
items.summary_fil: Tinatanggap ng battery shop ang lumang baterya kapag bumili ka ng bago, at binibili rin ng ilang junk shop.

items.summary_en: Leave old tires at the shop when you buy new ones. Never burn tires.
items.summary_fil: Iwan ang lumang gulong sa shop kapag bumili ng bago. Huwag kailanman sunugin ang gulong.

items.summary_en: Flatten it and keep it dry. Place it in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Itupi at panatilihing tuyo. Ilagay sa asul na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Donate clean rugs. Cut old carpet into pieces for the black bin, or ask for bulky pickup.
items.summary_fil: I-donate ang malinis na alpombra. Gupitin ang lumang karpet para sa itim, o itanong ang bulky.

items.summary_en: Donate whole pieces. Wrap broken ceramics in paper, label them and use the black bin.
items.summary_fil: I-donate ang buo. Balutin sa papel ang basag, lagyan ng label at ilagay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Ceramics aren't glass. Donate whole mugs; wrap broken ones, label BASAG and use the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Hindi salamin ang seramika. I-donate ang buo; balutin ang basag, lagyan ng BASAG at ilagay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Donate whole plates. Wrap broken ones, label BASAG and put them in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: I-donate ang buong pinggan. Balutin ang basag, lagyan ng BASAG at ilagay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Wrap broken ceramic spoons and put them in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Balutin ang basag na kutsarang seramika at ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Donate whole pieces. Wrap broken ones, label BASAG and put them in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: I-donate ang buo. Balutin ang basag, lagyan ng BASAG at ilagay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Remove the plastic liner, flatten the box and put it in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Tanggalin ang plastik sa loob, itupi ang kahon at ilagay sa asul na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Keep it whole, wrap it in its box, and bring it to a lamp take-back or hazardous collection.
items.summary_fil: Huwag basagin, balutin sa kahon, at dalhin sa lamp take-back o koleksyon ng mapanganib.

items.summary_en: Keep chargers and cables together and bring them to an e-waste drop-off.
items.summary_fil: Pagsama-samahin ang charger at kable at dalhin sa e-waste drop-off.

items.summary_en: Canisters mix cardboard, foil and metal. Reuse them for storage, then use the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Halo-halong karton, foil at metal ang lata ng chips. Gamitin ulit, saka sa itim.

items.summary_en: Replace a blown bulb or fuse first. Broken sets go to an e-waste drop-off.
items.summary_fil: Palitan muna ang pundidong bombilya o fuse. Ang sira ay sa e-waste drop-off.

items.summary_en: Make sure it is fully out, then place it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Siguraduhing patay na, saka ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Use broken pots as drainage in other pots. Otherwise, wrap and put them in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Gamitin ang basag na paso bilang drainage sa ibang paso. Kung hindi, balutin at ilagay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Coconut shells and husks go in the green bin, or give them away for crafts and gardening.
items.summary_fil: Ang bao at bunot ay sa berde, o ipamigay para sa crafts at paghahalaman.

items.summary_en: Empty the grounds into the green bin. Some brands take back capsules; otherwise, black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ilagay ang sapal sa berde. May brand na tumatanggap ng capsule; kung hindi, sa itim.

items.summary_en: Place them in the green bin or compost.
items.summary_fil: Ilagay sa berdeng basurahan o i-compost.

items.summary_en: Donate working ones; bring broken ones to an e-waste drop-off.
items.summary_fil: I-donate ang gumagana; dalhin ang sira sa e-waste drop-off.

items.summary_en: Rinse out the milk, then put it in the blue bin or sell it to a junk shop.
items.summary_fil: Banlawan ang gatas, saka ilagay sa asul o ibenta sa junk shop.

items.summary_en: Rubble doesn't go in household bins. Ask your barangay about debris collection or a hauler.
items.summary_fil: Hindi sa basurahan ng bahay ang debris. Itanong sa barangay ang koleksyon o hauler.

items.summary_en: Drain it, wash it with soap, let it dry, then put it in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Patuluin, hugasan ng sabon at patuyuin, saka ilagay sa asul na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Natural cork goes in the green bin. Plastic corks go in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ang natural na cork ay sa berde. Ang plastik na cork ay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Used cotton goes in the black bin. Never flush it.
items.summary_fil: Ang gamit na bulak ay sa itim. Huwag kailanman i-flush.

items.name_fil: Plastik na pakete ng online order
items.summary_en: Remove labels and tape, keep it clean, and bring it to a plastic collection programme or put it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Tanggalin ang label at tape, panatilihing malinis, at dalhin sa programa ng plastik o ilagay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Roll it up and tape it, then place it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Irolyo at lagyan ng tape, saka ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Peel them off inside out and put them in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Hubarin nang baligtad at ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Drinking glasses melt differently from bottles. Donate whole ones; wrap broken ones for the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Iba ang pagkatunaw ng baso sa bote. I-donate ang buo; balutin ang basag para sa itim.

items.summary_en: Do not throw it in any bin. Bring it to an e-waste collection point.
items.summary_fil: Huwag itapon sa kahit anong basurahan. Dalhin sa e-waste collection point.

items.summary_en: Bring old earphones to an e-waste drop-off. Wireless ones have a battery inside.
items.summary_fil: Dalhin ang lumang earphones sa e-waste drop-off. May baterya sa loob ang wireless.

items.summary_en: Paper egg trays go in the blue bin, or tear them up for compost. Plastic trays go in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ang papel na egg tray ay sa asul, o pirasuhin para sa compost. Ang plastik ay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Place it in the green bin or compost.
items.summary_fil: Ilagay sa berdeng basurahan o i-compost.

items.summary_en: A repair shop can often fix it. Otherwise, bring it to an e-waste collector or junk shop that takes appliances.
items.summary_fil: Kadalasang naaayos ito sa repair shop. Kung hindi, dalhin sa e-waste collector o junk shop na tumatanggap ng appliance.

items.summary_en: Use it to the end, then put it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Gamitin hanggang maubos, saka ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Keep it in its pack. Bring it to a pharmacy or hazardous waste collection point.
items.summary_fil: Iwan sa pakete. Dalhin sa botika o sa koleksyon ng mapanganib na basura.

items.summary_en: Fold it inward, cut the ear loops, and place it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Itupi papaloob, gupitin ang tali sa tainga, at ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: A few pieces can be wrapped for the black bin. For renovation waste, ask your barangay.
items.summary_fil: Puwedeng balutin ang ilang piraso para sa itim. Para sa basura ng renovation, itanong sa barangay.

items.summary_en: Flowers go in the green bin. Ribbons, plastic wrap and floral foam go in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ang bulaklak ay sa berde. Ang laso, plastik at floral foam ay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Keep it whole, wrap it, and bring it to a lamp take-back or hazardous waste collection.
items.summary_fil: Huwag basagin, balutin, at dalhin sa lamp take-back o koleksyon ng mapanganib na basura.

items.summary_en: Donate clean cushions. Old foam can stuff pet beds; otherwise, black bin or bulky pickup.
items.summary_fil: I-donate ang malinis na unan. Puwedeng palaman sa higaan ng alaga ang lumang foam; kung hindi, sa itim o bulky.

items.summary_en: Scrape and rinse it, then flatten it for the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Kayurin at banlawan, saka pitpitin para sa asul na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Scrape food into the green bin. No plastic or packaging.
items.summary_fil: Ilagay ang pagkain sa berdeng basurahan. Walang plastik o balot.

items.summary_en: Peels and cores go in the green bin or compost. Remove fruit stickers first.
items.summary_fil: Ang balat at ubod ay sa berdeng basurahan o compost. Tanggalin muna ang sticker.

items.summary_en: Patch leaks first. Cut old hoses into short lengths for the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Tapalan muna ang tagas. Putulin ang lumang hose nang maiikli para sa itim.

items.summary_en: Empty it and keep it whole. Place it in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Ubusin at huwag basagin. Ilagay sa asul na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Rinse it and reuse it. Otherwise, put the whole jar in the blue bin and the lid with metals.
items.summary_fil: Banlawan at gamitin ulit. Kung hindi, ilagay ang buong garapon sa asul at ang takip kasama ng metal.

items.summary_en: Use up or properly dispose of the medicine first, rinse the empty bottle, then put it in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Ubusin o itapon nang tama ang gamot, banlawan ang bote, saka ilagay sa asul.

items.summary_en: Compost grass and trimmings, or put them in the green bin. Never burn them.
items.summary_fil: I-compost ang damo at pinutol, o ilagay sa berde. Huwag kailanman sunugin.

items.summary_en: Keep using hair ties until they snap, then put them in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Gamitin ang ipit hanggang maputol, saka ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Halogen bulbs have no mercury. Wrap the bulb in paper and put it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Walang mercury ang halogen. Balutin sa papel at ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Empty and rinse it, then sell it to a junk shop or put it in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Ubusin at banlawan, saka ibenta sa junk shop o ilagay sa asul na basurahan.

items.summary_en: These have no mercury. Wrap the bulb and put it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Walang mercury ang mga ito. Balutin ang bombilya at ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Bring it to a cartridge take-back or e-waste collection point.
items.summary_fil: Dalhin sa take-back ng cartridge o sa e-waste collection point.

items.summary_en: Keep it in its labelled container and bring leftovers to hazardous waste collection.
items.summary_fil: Iwan sa lalagyang may label at dalhin ang natira sa koleksyon ng mapanganib.

items.summary_en: Donate or repair jeans. Old denim makes strong bags and patches.
items.summary_fil: I-donate o ipaayos ang maong. Nagagawang matibay na bag at tagpi ang lumang denim.

items.summary_en: Pouches are layered plastic and foil. Empty and rinse them, then use the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Patong-patong na plastik at foil ang pouch. Ubusin at banlawan, saka ilagay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Worn sponges go in the black bin. Reuse old ones for cleaning floors or shoes first.
items.summary_fil: Ang lumang espongha ay sa itim. Gamitin muna sa paglilinis ng sahig o sapatos.

items.summary_en: Put lancets in the same sealed hard container as needles. Ask your health centre where to bring it.
items.summary_fil: Ilagay ang lancet sa saradong matigas na lalagyan kasama ng karayom. Itanong sa health center kung saan dadalhin.

items.summary_en: Wipe your data, then donate, sell for parts, or bring it to an e-waste drop-off.
items.summary_fil: Burahin ang data, saka i-donate, ibenta bilang piyesa, o dalhin sa e-waste drop-off.

items.summary_en: Bring it to an e-waste or battery drop-off. A swollen battery must not be pressed or punctured.
items.summary_fil: Dalhin sa e-waste o battery drop-off. Huwag diinan o butasin ang namagang baterya.

items.summary_en: Place in the green bin or compost.
items.summary_fil: Ilagay sa berdeng basurahan o i-compost.

items.summary_en: LED bulbs have electronics inside. Bring them to an e-waste or lamp drop-off.
items.summary_fil: May electronics sa loob ang LED. Dalhin sa e-waste o lamp drop-off.

items.summary_en: Bring old LED tubes to an e-waste or lamp drop-off.
items.summary_fil: Dalhin ang lumang LED na tubo sa e-waste o lamp drop-off.

items.summary_en: Keep it whole and wrap it. Give it to staff or a collection point.
items.summary_fil: Huwag basagin at balutin. Ibigay sa staff o sa collection point.

items.summary_en: Empty it and keep it whole. Sell it to a junk shop or put it in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Ubusin at huwag basagin. Ibenta sa junk shop o ilagay sa asul na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Keep it dry and put it in the blue bin, or bring it to a junk shop with your other paper.
items.summary_fil: Panatilihing tuyo at ilagay sa asul, o dalhin sa junk shop kasama ng ibang papel.

items.summary_en: Donate it if it's clean and usable. Otherwise, ask your barangay for bulky-waste pickup.
items.summary_fil: I-donate kung malinis at magagamit pa. Kung hindi, itanong sa barangay ang bulky pickup.

items.summary_en: Keep it in its bottle with the cap on. Ask a pharmacy or health centre about take-back.
items.summary_fil: Iwan sa bote at nakatakip. Itanong sa botika o health center ang take-back.

items.summary_en: Don't break it. Seal it in a jar and bring it to hazardous waste collection.
items.summary_fil: Huwag basagin. Isara sa garapon at dalhin sa koleksyon ng mapanganib na basura.

items.summary_en: Collect caps in a can and put the can in the blue bin. Loose caps get lost in sorting.
items.summary_fil: Ipunin ang tansan sa lata at ilagay ang lata sa asul. Nawawala sa pag-uuri ang maluwag na tansan.

items.summary_en: Rinse and flatten it. Put it in the black bin unless your area collects cartons.
items.summary_fil: Banlawan at pitpitin. Ilagay sa itim maliban kung may koleksyon ng karton sa inyo.

items.summary_en: Donate a whole mirror. A broken one gets wrapped, labelled BASAG and put in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: I-donate ang buong salamin. Ang basag ay balutin, lagyan ng BASAG at ilagay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Wipe your data, then donate it or bring it to an e-waste drop-off. Never put it in a bin.
items.summary_fil: Burahin ang data, saka i-donate o dalhin sa e-waste drop-off. Huwag ilagay sa basurahan.

items.summary_en: Put used oil in a sealed container and bring it to an auto shop or hazardous waste collection.
items.summary_fil: Ilagay ang gamit na langis sa saradong lalagyan at dalhin sa auto shop o koleksyon ng mapanganib.

items.name_fil: Muriatic acid o panlinis ng inidoro
items.summary_en: Keep it capped and labelled. Bring leftovers to hazardous waste collection.
items.summary_fil: Panatilihing nakatakip at may label. Dalhin ang natira sa koleksyon ng mapanganib.

items.summary_en: Keep it closed and bring old nail polish to hazardous waste collection.
items.summary_fil: Panatilihing sarado at dalhin ang lumang cutex sa koleksyon ng mapanganib na basura.

items.summary_en: Keep it dry, stack and tie it, then sell it to a junk shop or put it in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Panatilihing tuyo, isalansan at itali, saka ibenta sa junk shop o ilagay sa asul.

items.summary_en: Tape both terminals: 9V batteries can spark if they touch metal. Bring them to battery collection.
items.summary_fil: Takpan ng tape ang dalawang terminal: kumikislap ang 9V kapag nadikit sa metal. Dalhin sa koleksyon.

items.summary_en: Empty and rinse it, then put the cup and lid in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ubusin at banlawan, saka ilagay ang baso at takip sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Donate it if it still works. Otherwise, sell it to a junk shop as scrap metal.
items.summary_fil: I-donate kung magagamit pa. Kung hindi, ibenta sa junk shop bilang scrap.

items.summary_en: Keep it closed. Bring it to a hazardous waste collection point.
items.summary_fil: Takpan nang mahigpit. Dalhin sa koleksyon ng mapanganib na basura.

items.summary_en: Keep it closed in its container and bring it to hazardous waste collection.
items.summary_fil: Panatilihing sarado sa lalagyan at dalhin sa koleksyon ng mapanganib na basura.

items.summary_en: Painted, varnished or treated wood doesn't compost. Small pieces go in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Hindi nabubulok nang ligtas ang pinturado o ginamot na kahoy. Ang maliliit ay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Empty it and flatten it, then drop it in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Ubusin ang laman at itupi, saka ilagay sa asul na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Empty it, then place it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ubusin ang laman, saka ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Used paper napkins go in the green bin. If they touched chemicals, use the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ang gamit na napkin ay sa berdeng basurahan. Kung nadikitan ng kemikal, sa itim.

items.summary_en: Keep it dry and uncrumpled. Place it in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Panatilihing tuyo at hindi lukot. Ilagay sa asul na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Place it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Bring old phone batteries to an e-waste or battery drop-off. Never puncture them.
items.summary_fil: Dalhin ang lumang baterya ng cellphone sa e-waste o battery drop-off. Huwag butasin.

items.summary_en: Tear off the clean top for the blue bin. The greasy part goes in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Punitin ang malinis na takip para sa asul. Ang may mantikang bahagi ay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Reuse it as many times as you can. When it's torn or dirty, put it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Gamitin ulit hangga't kaya. Kapag punit o marumi na, ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Empty it, remove the cap, and flatten it. Drop it in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Ubusin, tanggalin ang takip at pitpitin. Ilagay sa asul na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Empty and rinse it, then drop it in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Ubusin at banlawan, saka ilagay sa asul na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Empty it, then place it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ubusin ang laman, saka ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Place it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Reuse or give away usable boards. Glued board isn't compost; small pieces go in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Gamitin ulit o ipamigay ang magagamit pa. Hindi compost ang may pandikit; maliliit ay sa itim.

items.name_fil: Stick ng ice candy o toothpick
items.summary_en: Plain wooden sticks and toothpicks go in the green bin.
items.summary_fil: Ang simpleng kahoy na stick at palito ay sa berdeng basurahan.

items.summary_en: Donate whole bowls. Wrap broken ones, label BASAG and put them in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: I-donate ang buong mangkok. Balutin ang basag, lagyan ng BASAG at ilagay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Never put a power bank in a bin. Bring it to an e-waste or battery drop-off.
items.summary_fil: Huwag ilagay sa basurahan ang power bank. Dalhin sa e-waste o battery drop-off.

items.summary_en: Wash it and reuse it. When it's worn out, put the clean tub in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Hugasan at gamitin ulit. Kapag luma na, ilagay ang malinis na lalagyan sa asul na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Remove ink cartridges for take-back, then bring the printer to an e-waste drop-off.
items.summary_fil: Alisin ang cartridge para sa take-back, saka dalhin ang printer sa e-waste drop-off.

items.name_fil: Maliit na bote ng yogurt drink
items.summary_en: Rinse it, then put it in the black bin. Small #6 bottles are rarely accepted for recycling.
items.summary_fil: Banlawan, saka ilagay sa itim na basurahan. Bihirang tanggapin ang maliit na #6 na bote.

items.summary_en: Small pieces go in the black bin. Ask your barangay about larger construction scraps.
items.summary_fil: Ang maliliit na putol ay sa itim na basurahan. Itanong sa barangay ang malalaking tira ng konstruksyon.

items.summary_en: Heat-resistant glass can't be recycled with bottles. Wrap broken pieces and put them in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Hindi nare-recycle kasama ng bote ang pyrex. Balutin ang basag at ilagay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Put dirty rags in the black bin. Rags with paint, oil or solvent go to hazardous waste collection.
items.summary_fil: Ang maruming basahan ay sa itim. Ang may pintura, langis o solvent ay sa koleksyon ng mapanganib na basura.

items.summary_en: Keep it sealed and away from children and pets. Bring leftovers to hazardous waste collection.
items.summary_fil: Panatilihing selyado at malayo sa bata at alaga. Dalhin ang natira sa koleksyon ng mapanganib.

items.summary_en: Shiny receipts are thermal paper. Put them in the black bin, not with paper.
items.summary_fil: Thermal na papel ang makintab na resibo. Ilagay sa itim na basurahan, hindi kasama ng papel.

items.summary_en: When it no longer holds a charge, tape the ends and bring it to battery collection.
items.summary_fil: Kapag hindi na nagtatagal ang charge, takpan ng tape at dalhin sa koleksyon ng baterya.

items.summary_en: Ask the store about appliance take-back, or use an e-waste collector. Don't cut the cooling pipes.
items.summary_fil: Itanong sa tindahan ang take-back ng appliance, o gumamit ng e-waste collector. Huwag putulin ang tubo ng pampalamig.

items.summary_en: Remove the batteries for battery collection, then bring the remote to an e-waste drop-off.
items.summary_fil: Alisin ang baterya para sa koleksyon, saka dalhin ang remote sa e-waste drop-off.

items.summary_en: Return it to the store for your deposit. These bottles are refilled, not crushed.
items.summary_fil: Ibalik sa tindahan para sa deposito. Nire-refill ang mga boteng ito, hindi dinudurog.

items.name_fil: Rice cooker o maliit na appliance
items.summary_en: Try a repair shop first. Otherwise, bring it to an e-waste collector.
items.summary_fil: Subukan muna sa repair shop. Kung hindi, dalhin sa e-waste collector.

items.summary_en: Reuse it, or place it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Gamitin ulit, o ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Worn-out rubber gloves go in the black bin. Cut them into bands first if you like.
items.summary_fil: Ang lumang rubber gloves ay sa itim. Puwedeng gupitin muna bilang goma.

items.summary_en: Fix a broken strap first. Worn-out slippers go in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ayusin muna ang naputol na strap. Ang lumang tsinelas ay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Wrap it in paper, then place it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Balutin sa papel, saka ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.name_fil: Lata ng sardinas o corned beef
items.summary_en: Rinse it, press the lid inside, then sell it to a junk shop or put it in the blue bin.
items.summary_fil: Banlawan, ipasok ang takip sa loob, saka ibenta sa junk shop o ilagay sa asul.

items.summary_en: Sawdust from untreated wood is great for compost. From painted or treated wood, use the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Mabuti sa compost ang kusot mula sa hilaw na kahoy. Mula sa pinturado, sa itim ito.

items.summary_en: Replace a broken zipper or strap. Donate usable bags; the black bin is last.
items.summary_fil: Palitan ang sirang zipper o strap. I-donate ang magagamit pa; ang itim ang huli.

items.summary_en: Junk shops buy scrap metal and copper wire. Bundle it and bring it in.
items.summary_fil: Binibili ng junk shop ang scrap na metal at tansong alambre. Itali at dalhin.

items.summary_en: Bag shredded paper so it doesn't scatter, or add it to compost.
items.summary_fil: Isupot ang ginutay na papel para hindi kumalat, o idagdag sa compost.

items.summary_en: Empty any food, then place it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Alisin ang natirang pagkain, saka ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: A shoe repair shop can fix soles and stitching. Donate wearable pairs; the black bin is last.
items.summary_fil: Naaayos ng sapatero ang swelas at tahi. I-donate ang magagamit pa; ang itim ang huli.

items.summary_en: Mend small holes. Worn-out socks can be dusters, then go in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Tahiin ang maliliit na butas. Gawing pamunas ang luma, saka ilagay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Reupholster, sell or donate it. For broken sofas, ask your barangay for bulky pickup.
items.summary_fil: Ipa-reupholster, ibenta o i-donate. Para sa sira, itanong sa barangay ang bulky pickup.

items.summary_en: Scrape leftover food into the green bin, then put the container in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ilagay ang tirang pagkain sa berdeng basurahan, at ang lalagyan sa itim.

items.summary_en: Solar lights have a rechargeable battery. Bring them to an e-waste drop-off.
items.summary_fil: May rechargeable na baterya ang solar na ilaw. Dalhin sa e-waste drop-off.

items.summary_en: Do not puncture or burn it. Place it in the red bin or a collection point.
items.summary_fil: Huwag butasin o sunugin. Ilagay sa pulang basurahan o sa collection point.

items.summary_en: Place it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Empty any food, then place it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Alisin ang natirang pagkain, saka ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Never put loose needles in a bin. Seal them in a hard container and ask your barangay health centre or pharmacy.
items.summary_fil: Huwag maglagay ng karayom nang maluwag sa basurahan. Isara sa matigas na lalagyan at itanong sa health center o botika.

items.summary_en: Donate, repair or hand down clothes. Turn worn-out ones into rags before using the black bin.
items.summary_fil: I-donate, ipaayos o ipasa ang damit. Gawing basahan ang luma bago itapon sa itim.

items.summary_en: Paper tea bags go in the green bin. Remove staples; nylon "silky" bags go in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ang papel na tea bag ay sa berde. Tanggalin ang staple; ang nylon na tea bag ay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Donate a working TV. Bring broken ones to an e-waste collector; old tube TVs contain lead.
items.summary_fil: I-donate ang gumaganang TV. Dalhin ang sira sa e-waste collector; may lead ang lumang tube TV.

items.summary_en: Seal the used test parts in a bag and put it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Isara sa supot ang gamit na test at ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Empty and flatten it, then place it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ubusin at pitpitin, saka ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Too big for bins. Ask your barangay for bulky or construction waste pickup.
items.summary_fil: Masyadong malaki para sa basurahan. Itanong sa barangay ang pickup ng malalaking basura.

items.summary_en: Use old toothbrushes for cleaning, then put them in the black bin. Electric ones are e-waste.
items.summary_fil: Gamiting panlinis ang lumang sipilyo, saka ilagay sa itim. E-waste ang de-kuryente.

items.summary_en: Squeeze out what's left and put the tube in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Pigain ang natira at ilagay ang tubo sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Animal shelters often welcome old towels. Otherwise, cut them into rags.
items.summary_fil: Madalas tumatanggap ng lumang tuwalya ang animal shelter. Kung hindi, gawing basahan.

items.summary_en: Used underwear isn't donated. Put it in the black bin, or use clean old ones as rags.
items.summary_fil: Hindi idino-donate ang gamit na panloob. Ilagay sa itim, o gawing basahan ang malinis na luma.

items.summary_en: Let it cool, pour it into a sealed bottle, and never into the sink or drain.
items.summary_fil: Palamigin, ibuhos sa saradong bote, at huwag kailanman sa lababo o kanal.

items.summary_en: Place in the green bin.
items.summary_fil: Ilagay sa berdeng basurahan.

items.summary_en: Vapes have a lithium battery and nicotine. Bring them to an e-waste or battery drop-off.
items.summary_fil: May lithium na baterya at nicotine ang vape. Dalhin sa e-waste o battery drop-off.

items.summary_en: Vegetable trimmings go in the green bin or compost.
items.summary_fil: Ang tira at balat ng gulay ay sa berdeng basurahan o compost.

items.summary_en: Try a repair shop. Otherwise, junk shops and e-waste collectors take old washers.
items.summary_fil: Subukan sa repair shop. Kung hindi, tinatanggap ng junk shop at e-waste collector ang lumang washing machine.

items.summary_en: Flat glass is a different glass from bottles. Wrap it, label it BASAG and put it in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Iba ang salamin ng bintana sa bote. Balutin, lagyan ng BASAG at ilagay sa itim na basurahan.

items.summary_en: Give hangers back to a laundry shop, or add them to your scrap metal.
items.summary_fil: Ibalik ang hanger sa laundry shop, o isama sa scrap na metal.

items.summary_en: Repair or donate furniture. Broken pieces go to bulky pickup; small wood bits can go in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ipaayos o i-donate ang muwebles. Sa bulky pickup ang sira; ang maliliit na kahoy ay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Wooden or bamboo chopsticks go in the green bin. Plastic ones go in the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ang kahoy o kawayang chopsticks ay sa berde. Ang plastik ay sa itim.

items.summary_en: Crates and pallets are easy to reuse. Give them away, or ask about bulky pickup.
items.summary_fil: Madaling gamitin ulit ang kahon at pallet. Ipamigay, o itanong ang bulky pickup.
